77736-color-problems.title: A Practical Manual For The Lay Student Of Color
77736-color-problems.creator: Unknown
77736-color-problems.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The relation of color to light is much the same as that of music to sound. Color has its many hues, its long scales of tints and shades, its true and its false chords. Mere sound gives us but little pleasure; when developed, however, into its highest form, music, we are thrilled, as by the song of a bird, a favorite ballad, or a Beethoven Symphony.

arxiv-2110-11559.title: Single atom trapping in a metasurface lens optical tweezer
arxiv-2110-11559.creator: T.-W. Hsu, W. Zhu, T. Thiele, M. O. Brown, S. B. Papp, A. Agrawal, C. A. Regal
arxiv-2110-11559.description: Abstract Optical metasurfaces of subwavelength pillars have provided new capabilities for the versatile definition of the amplitude, phase, and polarization of light. In this work, we demonstrate that an efficient dielectric metasurface lens can be used to trap and image single neutral atoms with a long working distance from the lens of 3 mm.

arxiv-2310-05130.title: Fast-DetectGPT: Efficient Zero-Shot Detection of Machine-Generated Text via Conditional Probability Curvature
arxiv-2310-05130.creator: Guangsheng Bao, Yanbin Zhao, Zhiyang Teng, Linyi Yang, Yue Zhang
arxiv-2310-05130.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) have shown the ability to produce fluent and cogent content, presenting both productivity opportunities and societal risks. To build trustworthy AI systems, it is imperative to distinguish between machine-generated and human-authored content. The leading zero-shot detector, DetectGPT ( Mitchell et al. 2023 ) , showcases commendable performance but is marred by its intensive computational costs.

arxiv-2412-21191.title: Investigating Temporal and Spatial Variation of Jupiter’s Atmosphere with Radio Observations
arxiv-2412-21191.creator: Joanna Hardesty, Chris Moeckel, Imke de Pater
arxiv-2412-21191.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Joanna Hardesty, Chris Moeckel, Imke de Pater. We study the spatial and temporal variability in Jupiter’s atmosphere by comparing longitude-resolved brightness temperature maps from the Very Large Array (VLA) radio observatory and NASA’s Juno spacecraft Microwave Radiometer (MWR) taken between 2013 and 2018. Spatial variations in brightness temperature, as observed at radio wavelengths, indicate dynamics in the atmosphere as they trace spatial fluctuations in radio-absorbing trace gases or physical temperature.

arxiv-2502-07838.title: NanoVLMs: How small can we go and still make coherent Vision Language Models?
arxiv-2502-07838.creator: Mukund Agarwalla*, Himanshu Kumar*, Raj Dandekar, Rajat Dandekar, Sreedath Panat
arxiv-2502-07838.description: Abstract Vision-Language Models (VLMs), such as GPT-4V and Llama 3.2 vision, have garnered significant research attention for their ability to leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) in multimodal tasks. However, their potential is constrained by inherent challenges, including proprietary restrictions, substantial computational demands, and limited accessibility.

arxiv-2510-10170.title: Uniformly- S S -pseudo-projective modules Thanks: (⋆) Corresponding author
arxiv-2510-10170.creator: Mohammad Adarbeh (⋆), Mohammad Saleh
arxiv-2510-10170.description: Abstract . In this paper, we introduce the notion of uniformly- S S -pseudo-projective ( u u - S S -pseudo-projective) modules as a generalization of u u - S S -projective modules. Let R R be a ring and S S a multiplicative subset of R R .

arxiv-2510-25800.title: FreIE: Low-Frequency Spectral Bias in Neural Networks for Time-Series Tasks
arxiv-2510-25800.creator: Jialong Sun, Xinpeng Ling, Jiaxuan Zou, Jiawen Kang, Kejia Zhang
arxiv-2510-25800.description: Abstract The inherent autocorrelation of time series data presents an ongoing challenge to multivariate time series prediction. Recently, a widely adopted approach has been the incorporation of frequency domain information to assist in long-term prediction tasks. Many researchers have independently observed the spectral bias phenomenon in neural networks, where models tend to fit low-frequency signals before high-frequency ones.

arxiv-2511-03368.title: TripleWin: Fixed-Point Equilibrium Pricing for Data-Model Coupled Markets Thanks: Correspondence to Yun Xiong (yunx@fudan.edu.cn) and Lei You (leiyo@dtu.dk)
arxiv-2511-03368.creator: 1 st Hongrun Ren, 2 nd Yun Xiong ✉, 3 rd Lei You ✉, 4 th Yingying Wang, 5 th Haixu Xiong, 6 th Yangyong Zhu
arxiv-2511-03368.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by 1 st Hongrun Ren, 2 nd Yun Xiong ✉, 3 rd Lei You ✉, 4 th Yingying Wang, 5 th Haixu Xiong, 6 th Yangyong Zhu. The rise of the machine learning (ML) model economy has intertwined markets for training datasets and pre-trained models. However, most pricing approaches still separate data and model transactions or rely on broker-centric pipelines that favor one side.

pmc-10535206.title: Managing Energy Consumption of Devices with Multiconnectivity by Deep Learning and Software-Defined Networking
pmc-10535206.creator: Ramiza Shams, Atef Abdrabou, Mohammad Al Bataineh, Kamarul Ariffin Noordin
pmc-10535206.description: Multiconnectivity allows user equipment/devices to connect to multiple radio access technologies simultaneously, including 5G, 4G (LTE), and WiFi. It is a necessity in meeting the increasing demand for mobile network services for the 5G and beyond wireless networks, while ensuring that mobile operators can still reap the benefits of their present investments.

pmc-10745935.title: A Small-Molecule Fluorescent Probe for the Detection of Mitochondrial Peroxynitrite
pmc-10745935.creator: Han Dong, Meng-Yu Tang, Shili Shen, Xiao-Qun Cao, Xiao-Fan Zhang, Nathan W Luedtke
pmc-10745935.description: Reactive oxygen species (ROS) are pivotal signaling molecules that control a variety of physiological functions. As a member of the ROS family, peroxynitrite (ONOO−) possesses strong oxidation and nitrification abilities. Abnormally elevated levels of ONOO− can lead to cellular oxidative stress, which may cause several diseases.

pmc-11317454.title: KAT6A/YAP/TEAD4 pathway modulates osteoclastogenesis by regulating the RANKL/OPG ratio on the compression side during orthodontic tooth movement
pmc-11317454.creator: Kuang Tan, Jiayi Wang, Xinyu Su, Yunfei Zheng, Weiran Li
pmc-11317454.description: BackgroundOrthodontic tooth movement (OTM) is a dynamic equilibrium of bone remodeling, involving the osteogenesis of new bone and the osteoclastogenesis of old bone, which is mediated by mechanical force. Periodontal ligament stem cells (PDLCSs) in the periodontal ligament (PDL) space can transmit mechanical signals and regulate osteoclastogenesis during OTM.

pmc-11503343.title: Towards Characterization of Hass Avocado Peel and Pulp Proteome during Postharvest Shelf Life
pmc-11503343.creator: Carolina Camacho-Vázquez, José Miguel Elizalde-Contreras, Francisco Antonio Reyes-Soria, Juan Luis Monribot-Villanueva, José Antonio Guerrero-Analco, Janet Juarez-Escobar, Olinda Velázquez-López, Thuluz Meza-Menchaca, Esaú Bojórquez-Velázquez, Jesús Alejandro Zamora-Briseño, Monica Ramirez-Vazquez,
pmc-11503343.description: In recent years, avocados have gained worldwide popularity as a nutritive food. This trend is causing a rise in the production of this fruit, which is accompanied by several problems associated with monocultural practices. Despite massive economic gains, limited molecular and structural information has been generated about avocado ripening.

pmc-11605216.title: Dynamic Network-Level Traffic Speed and Signal Control in Connected Vehicle Environment
pmc-11605216.creator: Zihao Yuan, Xiaoqing Zeng, Omprakash Kaiwartya
pmc-11605216.description: The advent of connected vehicles holds significant promise for enhancing existing traffic signal and vehicle speed control methods. Despite this potential, there has been a lack of concerted efforts to address issues related to vehicle fuel consumption and emissions during travel across multiple intersections controlled by traffic signals.

pmc-11690830.title: IMPLEMENT A SELF-ADMINISTERED, SMARTPHONE APP-BASED GAIT ASSESSMENT FOR FUTURE INTERVENTION IN OLDER ADULTS
pmc-11690830.creator: On-Yee (Amy) Lo, Pei-An Lee, Wanting Yu, Junhong Zhou, Brad Manor
pmc-11690830.description: Gait metrics reflect functional capacity and sensitively predict adverse health outcomes. Measuring gait performance – under normal (i.e. walking quietly at a self-selected speed) and “dual-task” conditions (i.e. walking while performing an unrelated cognitive task) – is recommended for assessing and monitoring physical and cognitive functions in older adults.

pmc-12660328.title: The stem ethyl acetate extract of Costus pictus D.DON exhibits cytotoxic activity in human cancer cells via. intrinsic apoptotic caspase pathway as a first report
pmc-12660328.creator: Alex Zohmachhuana, Mathipi Vabeiryureilai, Lalchhandami Tochhawng, Nachimuthu Senthil Kumar, Thangaraj Parimelazhagan, F Lalnunmawia
pmc-12660328.description: The leaves of Costus pictus have been reported to have anti-diabetic properties. Nevertheless, a comprehensive analysis of the entire plant remains to be established. The current objective was to assess the phytochemical content, antioxidant capacity and anti-cancer potential. Three fractions - hexane, ethyl acetate, and methanol extract were obtained by sequential extraction.

pmc-12749458.title: Light-powered end-to-end neutron detection and imaging with an edge-deployed optical AI chip
pmc-12749458.creator: Shanny Lin, Hanqing Zhu, Steven Clayton, C L Morris, David Z Pan, Zhaowen Tang, Ray T Chen, Zhehui Wang
pmc-12749458.description: Neutron detection is widely used in many applications including nuclear physics, nuclear energy, nuclear technologies and nuclear safeguards. Developing an end-to-end neutron detection and imaging workflow paves way towards fully automated processes for many applications. We implemented an automated workflow for neutron detection experiments which use a solid state image sensor to capture neutron hits as a digital image.

pmc-12987029.title: Survey of Resource Scheduling Technologies for Ground-Based Space Target Surveillance Radar Networks Focused on Cataloging Tasks
pmc-12987029.creator: Yali Liu, Wei Xiong, Xiaolan Yu
pmc-12987029.description: Cataloging task resource scheduling is a key technology for the efficient utilization of ground-based radar networks and for supporting space situational awareness. This problem is highly challenging due to the large scale of tasks, strict time window constraints, and complex resource-task mapping relationships.

pmc-13066585.title: Gas separation with binary-cooperative heterogeneous membranes
pmc-13066585.creator: Bo Wang, Chen Zhang, Junrui Zhang, Ji-kun Yin, Xiaomin Song, Haochen Ye, Qing-hua Li, Jun-chao Lao, Tie Wang
pmc-13066585.description: Advanced polymer membranes exhibit competitive performance in gas separation. However, rationally designing a polymer membrane with high gas separation performance and structural robustness simultaneously remains challenging. Herein, we present a microzone interfacial polymerization approach to reconstruct the polymer network through the rearrangement of attached functional groups, forming a heterogeneous structure with a crumpled morphology.

pmc-13217503.title: Inflammation-driven mitochondrial dysfunction and ROS accumulation orchestrate pulmonary fibrotic remodeling in sepsis
pmc-13217503.creator: Zhaoqian Zhong, Kan Wu, Junhao Wang, Guiming Chen, Haihua Luo, Guangqin Chen, Chang Sun, Danyan Guo, Leyi Li, Lei Li, Yong Jiang
pmc-13217503.description: Inflammation-induced pulmonary fibrosis is an irreversible and severe complication that leads to persistent decline in lung function and increased mortality; however, its early pathogenesis is still unclear. This study aimed to systematically elucidate the initiation mechanism of pulmonary fibrosis in the early stages of inflammation.

pmc-13305688.title: RNA结合蛋白相分离在激素性股骨头坏死中的作用机制
pmc-13305688.creator: Tianfa HU, Jie HAN, Yachao WU, Guojun YAO, Kebin SHANG, Zhen LIAO, Bin NONG, Kailong YU, 柳 宋
pmc-13305688.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). 激素性股骨头坏死(steroid-associated necrosis of the femoral head，SANFH)是一种由糖皮质激素诱发的难治性骨关节疾病，其病理机制复杂，临床干预手段有限。近年来研究表明，RNA结合蛋白(RNA binding proteins，RBPs)通过液-液相分离(liquid-liquid phase separation，LLPS)在转录后调控、细胞信号转导及代谢平衡中发挥关键作用。在SANFH的发病机制中，RBPs通过LLPS参与调控骨代谢关键环节，可能成为潜在干预靶点。RBPs的结构域特性、RNA结合状态及三磷酸腺苷(adenosine triphosphate，ATP)微环境等因素可动态调节其相分离行为，进而影响DNA损伤修复、铁死亡、外泌体形成、转化生长因子-β(transforming growth factor-beta，TGF-β)/Sma和Mad相关蛋白7(Sma- and Mad-related protein 7，Smad7)信号通路、炎症小体激活及m6A修饰等过程，这些均与SANFH的发生和发展密切相关。靶向调控RBPs相分离，有望通过多途径干预骨代谢失衡、抑制细胞死亡及减轻炎症反应。将RBPs相分离这一前沿细胞生物学机制与SANFH的多阶段、多通路病理进程进行串联，构建了一个新的机制框架，这为SANFH的防治提供新思路。未来需进一步明确RBPs相分离在SANFH中的具体作用机制，并探索基于相分离调控的精准治疗策略。Keywords: RNA结合蛋白, 激素性股骨头坏死, 糖皮质激素, 相分离, 外泌体, m6A修饰, 铁死亡 激素性股骨头坏死(steroid-associated necrosis of the femoral head，SANFH)是一种由于长期使用糖皮质激素等原因导致股骨头代谢异常、脂质代谢失衡和血液微循环紊乱，最终引发骨小梁骨折、骨组织坏死塌陷、髋关节功能障碍的难治性骨骼疾病，是最常见的非外伤性股骨头坏死类型[1]。在临床治疗中，由于风湿性疾病、免疫相关疾病等对高剂量糖皮质激素高度依赖且治疗周期长，SANFH发病率正逐年上升。据统计，中国是股骨头坏死患者数量较多的国家之一，每年需要接受治疗的患者例数超800万[2]；多中心流行病学研究报告[3]指出，SANFH约占全部股骨头坏死病例的24.1%。同时，由于糖皮质激素在临床治疗中难以替代，探究SANFH的具体发病机制极为迫切。 RNA结合蛋白(RNA-binding proteins，RBPs)是一种通过与RNA分子结合并参与基因表达调控和转录过程的蛋白质，其在细胞稳态维持和组织发育中起关键作用[4]。RBPs可通过液-液相分离(liquid-liquid phase separation，LLPS)形成无膜细胞器，这是一种由特定蛋白质和核酸在最优条件和浓度下，在水环境中引发的可逆相变，形成一个密集的液滴，即“凝聚体”[5]。目前，研究[6-7]发现LLPS在DNA修复、细胞信号转导、代谢调控等方面起重要作用。SANFH的病理机制聚焦于脂代谢紊乱、氧化应激、血管损伤和细胞凋亡/焦亡等。然而，这些下游事件是否存在一个共同的、更上游的分子调控枢纽，以及RBPs的LLPS是否参与其中，仍需要进一步探索。近年来研究[8]发现，RBPs通过LLPS形成的无膜细胞器，也是协调基因转录、翻译、信号转导和应激反应的关键空间平台。在多种退行性疾病中，RBPs的异常相分离或是致病的核心环节。因此，糖皮质激素可能通过干扰股骨头关键靶细胞内特定RBPs的相分离稳态，促使其从动态的、功能性的“工作平台”转变为病理性的、功能失调的凝聚体，同时扰乱DNA修复、铁死亡、炎症信号、成骨/破骨分化等多个下游通路，最终协同驱动骨坏死的发生，而药物通过参与调控RBPs的LLPS则具备一定的治疗潜力。 本文旨在通过系统分析糖皮质激素诱导股骨头坏死发生的病理进程，总结RBPs在各领域研究中的最新进展，归纳RBPs通过LLPS在DNA修复、铁死亡调控和外泌体形成、转化生长因子-β(transforming growth factor-beta，TGF-β)/Sma和Mad相关蛋白7(Sma- and Mad-related protein 7，Smad7)信号通路调控、炎症因子调节等环节中的作用机制，对RBPs在SANFH中的治疗作用提出展望，并对潜在靶点的临床转化应用提出合理方向，为靶向RBPs的SANFH治疗策略提供新的思路。 RBPs相分离的调控机制 RBPs上的无序结构域影响LLPS RBPs上的无序结构域在LLPS中发挥重要推动作用。酵母核糖体生成因子是一种内在无序的RBPs，具有8个重复的带正电荷且无结构的核酸结合基序，这种多个基序的结构能够通过协同作用催化RNA折叠，驱动相分离过程[9]。严重急性呼吸系统综合征冠状病毒2型(severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2，SARS-CoV-2)的核衣壳蛋白能够与转录活性DNA结合蛋白(transactive response DNA-binding protein，TDP-43)形成生物分子凝聚体，这一过程依赖于N蛋白的C末端结构域和TDP-43的内在无序C末端结构域的LLPS，并且在有RNA存在的情况下，这一过程会显著加快[10]。RBPs多聚腺苷酸结合蛋白核1(polyadenylate-binding protein nuclear 1，PABPN1)通过其N端无序结构域和RNA识别基序的LLPS促进核内多聚腺苷酸结构域的形成[11](图1)。富含碱性氨基酸的相互作用域蛋白1A包含一个类似朊病毒的结构域，其能够通过液相聚集促进液态聚集体的形成[12]。肽基脯氨酰异构酶A内的无序区域有助于其与其他蛋白质或核酸相互作用，引发LLPS，提高细胞的抗应激能力[13]。 pmc-13613338.title: Neurovascular-metabolic coupling links hearing loss to cognitive impairment: Evidence from GABA and cerebral blood flow in presbycusis
pmc-13613338.creator: Yao Wang, Shuya Wang, Wen Ma, Wenqing Li, Weilong Fu, Fuxin Ren, Bing Liu, Richard A.E. Edden, Muwei Li, Xinjuan Zhang, Fei Gao
pmc-13613338.description: Hearing loss is recognized as the leading modifiable risk factor for dementia. However, the neurobiological pathways bridging auditory dysfunction and cognitive decline remain poorly understood. We hypothesized that a neurovascular-metabolic cascade, involving neurotransmitter imbalances and perfusion deficits, underlies this link. We recruited 124 patients with presbycusis and 91 age-matched health controls.
